title: Wide Columns Changed to Lists

illustrates.quote: 10.9.2 Matching Wide Columns a. If the columns are too wide to fit side by side across the width of the page, change the columns to list format with each list beginning in cell 1.

blocks.text: See if you know what each word below means. Match each word in column 1 with its meaning in column 2.
